बाल संस्कृतम्

Sanskrit prayers, Gītā verses, letters, words and grammar for children

    Each verse is read line by line in an Indian male voice, with a soft tanpura behind it. You can also add your own recording to any prayer from its player screen.

    Twenty verses from the Bhagavad Gītā chosen for children, read line by line with a simple meaning and a few words to know.

    Tap a letter to hear it with a word that starts with it.

    Six small lessons. Tap any example to hear it, then say it back.

    Your turn, say it 🗣️
